title: Calibre
summary: Ebook library and format-conversion application. Useful as a document utility, not itself an adult-content-aware AI translation model.
documentation_observations: Official website and manual document ebook library management, conversion and editing.
Using Calibre for an AI translation workflow requires a separate translation engine or plugin.
limitations: Official documentation reviewed, but not installed or benchmarked by NaughtyBoddy. Low-refusal behavior, actual quality, privacy, performance and current release availability are not proven.
